versions.changelog:
Initial release with recursive self-improvement capability for skills ecosystem.

- Scans skills to detect improvement opportunities (missing self-evolution, YAML issues, missing learner).
- Proposes safe, reviewable patch plans (append/copy only, never delete/overwrite).
- Applies patches in a sandbox with validation and rollback on failure.
- Tracks and records all changes for auditable evolution history.
- Includes integrated self-learning to improve performance and personalize over time.
- Command-line interface for scanning, proposing, applying, and self-testing improvements.
